coordinate_contract: ARCore world meters; unrotated CPU image; c2w column-major; OpenCV c2w flips local Y/Z
camera_pose_source: ARCore physical camera pose; not COLMAP-refined
timestamp_contract: SDK current Frame.acquireCameraImage pairing; frame and CPU image timestamps strictly advance independently; clock equality is not assumed
quality_note: Frame count only; coverage, blur and pose accuracy still require validation
